description: Base image updates only (design §14.5): a pull request when a pinned tag in file-connector/docker/base-images.env moves to a new digest. Re-run the image tests on the branch before merging.

packageRules.description: Follow the pinned tags (Java 25, Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04); moving to another tag is a deliberate change, not an update.
One pull request for all base image digests.

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `scripts/it-minikube.sh -Dit.test='*ImageIT' -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false` on this branch, then `scripts/base-images.sh` should report every base as current.
